studio.ed.styles-note: Taɓawa ɗaya don kamanni cikakke. Komai yana iya gyaruwa, sannan Fitarwa.
studio.ed.highlight-note: Kalmar da ake karantawa tana canza launi, bisa lokacin kalmomin makarancin kansa.
studio.ed.untimed: Wannan makaranci ba shi da lokacin kalmomi, don haka aya gaba ɗaya tana bayyana a lokaci ɗaya (ba a taɓa yin hasashe ba).
studio.ed.highlight-needs-timings: Wannan karatu ba shi da lokacin kalmomi, don haka ba za a iya haskaka kalmomi ba (ba a taɓa yin hasashe ba).
studio.ed.touches-note: Tasiri masu natsuwa a bango da haske mai taushi; ba a taɓa motsa ko lanƙwasa rubutun Alƙur'ani ba. Har {n} a lokaci ɗaya, tare da Sinima, Ƙyalli da Duhun gefe.
studio.ed.darken-note: Yadda bango ke duhu a bayan rubutu: daga babu zuwa kusan baƙi. Kaɗan yana sa aya ta kasance mai sauƙin karantawa.
studio.ed.order-note: Fage suna riƙe tsawonsu; tsari kawai ke canzawa.
studio.ed.scene-adjust-note: Don wannan fage kawai. Duhuwa tana tausasa bango mai cunkoso don aya ta fito fili.
studio.ed.nature-note: Sautin yanayi mai natsuwa a ƙarƙashin karatu. Ko a cikakken ƙara yana nan ƙasa da muryar makaranci sosai. Ba waƙa ba ko kaɗan. Samfoti = fitarwa.
studio.ed.frame-note: Nuna duka yana riƙe bidiyo da hotuna na kwance cikakku, a kan kwafinsu mai duhuwa da ya cika firam. Cika yana yanke su zuwa girman firam.
studio.ed.echo-note: Yana sa muryar makaranci kanta ta yi kamar a ɗaki, zaure ko masallaci: ba a ƙara komai ba. Fili = girman wuri, Jinkiri = tsawon amon, Maimaitawa = dawowar muryar. Samfoti = fitarwa.
studio.ed.cinema-note: Kalmomi suna haskakawa a hankali tare da muryar makaranci; fage yana fitowa daga duhu, yana matsowa kusa a hankali, yana tausasa a bayan aya kuma ya koma cikin duhu a ƙarshe. Inda ayar take koyaushe yana nan.
studio.ed.tight-note: Bidiyon yana buɗuwa kafin murya kaɗan: shirun farko kawai ake yankewa, ba wata kalma ba. Tsayawa tsakanin ayoyi suna nan yadda suke.

ranks.rk.title: Matsayi
ranks.rk.sub: Karanta, saurara kuma ku yi bidiyo tare
ranks.rk.outLine: Shiga gasar masu karatu 15 a wannan mako. Abin da manhajar ta duba da kanta ne kawai ke ƙirguwa.
ranks.rk.outSub: Shiga da Google don shiga gasar wannan mako, allon duniya da alluna tare da iyalinku da abokanku. Abin da manhajar ta duba da kanta ne kawai ke ƙirguwa: shafukan da aka karanta har cikakken lokacinsu, karatun da aka kunna da gaske, surorin da aka gama da bidiyon da aka yi.
ranks.rk.iPtsBody: XP yana da wannan alama mai launin shunayya. Duk abin da kuke yi a manhajar yana samar da shi. XP na wannan mako yana tantance matsayinku a gasarku da kowane allo, kuma yana komawa 0 idan mako ya ƙare a Magaribar Juma'a. Dukkan XP da kuka taɓa samu yana ba siffarku matakinta. Ba a taɓa kashe XP.
ranks.rk.iEarn: Abin da ke samar da XP

ranks.rk.iLightBody: Haske yana da tauraro. Yana fitowa daga akwatuna (buri, azkar, kyaututtuka) kuma kuna kashe shi a shago. Haske ba ya ƙirguwa a Matsayi, kuma XP ba ya taɓa zama Haske.
ranks.rk.iLeagueBody: Kowane mako kuna gasa da mutane har {size} a matakinku. Gasanni suna bin tafiyar Sahabbai bisa tsari: Darul Arƙam, Hijira, Badar, Khandaƙ, Fatahu Makka. Gasar da ke gaba tana gaba ne kawai a tarihi, ba ta nufin wani Sahabi ya fi wani ba. Mako yana gudana daga Asabar zuwa Juma'a kuma yana ƙarewa a Magaribar Juma'a, a lokacin Magaribar inda kuke zaune. Ana haɗa gasanni da mutanen da agogonsu ke kusa, kuma sakamako yana bayyana idan Magaribar kowa ta wuce. Na sama {up} suna hawa mataki kuma suna samun kyaututtuka, na ƙasa {down} suna sauka.
ranks.rk.iWhenBody: 'Yan daƙiƙoƙi bayan an ƙirga shafi, an ci darasi ko an kunna minti ɗaya, idan kuna kan intanet. Yayin da Matsayi a buɗe yake, allon yana sabunta kansa.
